richiami.difetto: Škoda Auto has discovered that there is a risk with the Kodiaq model from a limited production period that the edge of the inner frame of the front seats may compromise the integrity of the side airbag when activated. This situation may reduce the protective effect of the side airbag which could result in an increased risk of injury to passengers in the event of an accident.For safety reasons your vehicle must be repaired. We strongly recommend that you contact an authorized Škoda service center as soon as possible to arrange a repair date. In the first instance we ask that you contact your local ŠKODA authorised repairer as soon as possible to make an appointment. The ŠKODA authorised repairer closest to you can be found on https://tools.skoda.co.uk/find-a-retailer

richiami.difetto: null Incorrectly parameterised airbag control units may have been fitted. On incorrectly parameterised airbag control units the diagnosis function of the side crash sensors is deactivated. Therefore, a potential fault in the side airbag system cannot be recognised and the airbag warning light does not come on.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: The recall concerns certain SKODA Citigo vehicles, produced from January 2013 to 13 March 2013, with VINs from 630729 to 640502 and from 600005 to 600006.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 06/05/2013
richiami.titolo: null Incorrectly parameterised airbag control units may have been fitted.

richiami.difetto: Some vehicles may be fitted with airbag control units with incorrect parameters programmed. On these vehicles the diagnostic function for the side crash sensors is deactivated resulting in potential faults not being recognised and the airbag warning not illuminating.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to re programme the airbag control unit.
richiami.titolo: SIDE AIRBAG DIAGNOSTIC FUNCTION DISABLED

richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and check the tightening torque of the earth connection.
richiami.titolo: RISK OF FIRE

richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the wiring to the control unit checked and rectified should this be necessary.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the two mass flywheel can become damaged because of a not optimally aligned through-flow restrictor in the clutch pressure pipe. This situation can lead to total failure of the flywheel and under unfavourable conditions a fire
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the make of the two mass flywheel identified and if necessary replaced together with the breather of the clutch pressure pipe.
richiami.titolo: FLYWHEEL MAY FAIL RESULTING IN FIRE

richiami.difetto: It is advised that on some vehicles fitted with a 3 and 4 cylinder pump injector engine the bolts of the tandem fuel pump cover may break due to a bolt production fault. As a result the pump housing will not be tight and a diesel fuel leak may occur.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the pump checked for being of a certain manufacture. If found to be within the affected range the pump housing cover bolts will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: BOLTS OF THE TANDEM FUEL PUMP COVER MAY BREAK

richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to check and if necessary correct control unit
richiami.titolo: THE SIDE AIR BAG WIRING MAY BE INCORRECT

richiami.difetto: The rear window wiper may loosen during high speed driving.  This may cause the wiper to break off.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the wiper arm and blade
richiami.titolo: REAR WINDOW WIPER MAY BREAK OFF

richiami.difetto: On Octavia vehicles within the affected chassis number range tension cracks may occur on the vacuum pipe to the brake servo in the area of the pipe connections due to a manufacturing fault. If a vacuum pipe leaks the brake servo loses it's function. Without servo assistance a lot more force must be used on the pedal. But this will not lead to total failure of the brake system.
richiami.rimedio: The fitted vacuum pipes will be checked and if necessary replaced.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE VACUUM SUPPLY PIPE CONCERN

richiami.difetto: There is a risk that an electrical fault in the anti lock brake control unit (ABS) can cause overheating of related electrical components. This may lead to fire damage and cause the service brake to revert to a non-anti lock mode of operation.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to check the part number and supplier code of the ABS control unit. Renew the ABS control unit where found necessary.
richiami.titolo: ANTI LOCK BRAKE CONTROL UNIT CONCERN

richiami.difetto: There is a risk that an electrical fault in the anti lock brake control unit (ABS) can cause overheating of related electrical components. This may lead to fire damage and cause the service brake to revert to a non-anti lock mode of operation.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to check the part number and supplier code of the ABS control unit. Renew the ABS control unit where found necessary.
richiami.titolo: ANTI LOCK BRAKE CONTROL UNIT CONCERN

richiami.difetto: Fuel tank may leak.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles check the fuel tank for leaks and replace where necessary.
richiami.titolo: FUEL LEAKAGE CONCERN

richiami.difetto: The passenger airbag may not release correctly because of a leak in the pressure reservoir of the gas generator.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the passenger air bag.
richiami.titolo: PASSENGER AIR BAG CONCERN

richiami.difetto: On Skoda Octavia LX vehicles which are not equipped with ABS brake servo units designed only for ABS vehicles have been installed. Due to the different performance of the brake servo units a risk exists that the brakes could lock under severe driving conditions (ice snow).
richiami.rimedio: Recall vehicles to replace the brake servo unit.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY THAT AN INCORRECT BRAKE VACUUM SERVO HAS BEEN FITTED

richiami.difetto: The wiring to the air bag control unit can chafe on the brake/clutch lever. This may lead to malfunction of the air bag unit.
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the air bag wiring re-routed and fixed to the bulkhead. Any wiring found to be damaged will be replaced or repaired.
richiami.titolo: MALFUNCTION OF AIR BAG

richiami.difetto: The blanking bolts fitted to redundant seat belt mounting points may be excessively long and could chafe on the rear brake hoses. This could damage the hoses and lead to loss of brake fluid.
richiami.rimedio: The affected vehicles are being recalled for removal of the subject bolts. These are being replaced with a suitable plastic rivet.
richiami.titolo: CHAFING OF REAR BRAKE HOSES

richiami.difetto: A. Potential loss of electrical power in any one of the fuse board circuits e.g. lights or windscreen wipers) due to poor quality soldered connections and possible damage to wiring behind the central console as a result of contact with the heater
richiami.rimedio: A. Replace the fuse board with a quality assured unit and fit a protective clip to the heater controls on all the affected vehicles.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LOSS OF ELECTRICAL CIRCUITS/HANDBRAKE LEVER MOUNTING BRACKET SECURITY.
